incident-bot: :rotating_light: PAGER: Elevated restart rate for redwood-16k in us-west-2. 60% of replicas restarted in last 6m. Priority: P1. Assigned: ashley (oncall).
ashley (oncall): acknowledged — jumping in. priya, any quick signal?
priya (eng-runtime): seeing repeated `cudaErrorMemoryAllocation` during prefill. container id inference-rt-203 keeps exiting with 137. Looks like single-request prefill ~120k tokens attempting KV allocations.
priya (eng-runtime): paste of trimmed logs: ```
03:45:10 Prefill: estimated_tokens=121482 model=redwood-16k
03:45:10 KVCache: attempting contiguous alloc bytes=2.1GB
03:45:11 Runtime: cudaMalloc failed: out of memory
03:45:11 ContainerManager: pid 1 terminated with status 137
```
leo (sre): metrics corroborate — GPU mem usage spikes to >98% then crash. Alerts: gpu-prefill-oom-usw2. Grafana: https://grafana/redwood/d/prefill/oom-3991234567
nina (ml-infra): telemetry shows a handful of clients uploading multi-day chat dumps into a single prefill. This is not typical. We have two support tickets open referencing timeouts.
sam (support): customer tickets 4310 and 4312. Both report generation failures around 03:45. One customer included the whole conversation history in a single request.
ashley (oncall): mitigation options? We should avoid paging repeatedly. ideas: server-side hard limit, automatic trimming, or route to lower-memory quant variant.
priya (eng-runtime): immediate plan I can enact in <5m: 1) enforce transient max_prefill_tokens=65536 on the redwood-16k route 2) enable lossy_prefill_trim which drops oldest turns beyond 48k tokens 3) toggle prefetch_kv=false for requests > 48k to avoid big contiguous allocations. I can roll 1+2 as config change instantly; 3 requires minor restart on agents but doable in ~10m.
leo (sre): do 1 and 2 now as canary to 12% of capacity. I'll suppress duplicate OOM pages for 20m while we validate.
priya (eng-runtime): applying route override: ```
redwoodctl route patch --path /v1/generate --model redwood-16k --set max_prefill_tokens=65536 --set lossy_prefill_trim=48k --canary=12% --note "mitigate prefab OOMs"
```
Canaryed at 03:51. Monitoring.
priya (eng-runtime): initial canary stable for 90s, expanding to 50% at 03:53. Adding fallback policy next: when prefill_estimate > 65536 forward to redwood-4k-quant-ffloat.
nina (ml-infra): caution: redwood-4k-quant-ffloat has lower coherence for long context, but will keep service alive. Logging customers who hit fallback for follow up.
sam (support): updated customers: one prefers fallback; one wants full context and is willing to wait for postmortem. CS: I'll flag for outreach.
leo (sre): node-level action: node gpu-node-22 showing high fragmentation. I'm cordoning gpu-node-22 and moving pods off. drain starting 03:56.
priya (eng-runtime): capturing previous logs and nvprof traces: ```
nvprof --unified-memory-profiling off -o /tmp/node22.nvprof
kubectl logs inference inference-rt-203 --previous > /tmp/rt-203-prev.log
```
nina (ml-infra): after drain I'll push allocator tweak that breaks KV cache into smaller chunked allocations rather than one big malloc; this should reduce fragmentation OOMs. QA requires a quick regression test — target deployment in ~48h.
ashley (oncall): repo: can we send a 503/413 for requests above 200k tokens instead of letting them crash? quick reject would be better UX.
priya (eng-runtime): agree — immediate safety net: add hard reject at edge for prefill_estimate > 200k with message: "Prefill too large; please chunk requests or contact support." I can add that in the edge LB within 4m.
priya (eng-runtime): edge rule added at 03:58: `edgectl limit add --route /v1/generate --header X-Prefill-Estimate --gt 200000 --status 413 --body 'prefill too large'`
leo (sre): suppression active for 20m. restart rate back to normal after canary expansion and node drain. current error rate reduced to baseline.
sam (support): CS note: both customers updated. one chose fallback, one accepted temporary trimming. No data loss reported.
ashley (oncall): incident summary draft: 03:45-03:59 partial degradation for redwood-16k in us-west-2 due to very large prefill requests (~120k tokens) causing KV cache contiguous allocation OOMs -> container restarts. Mitigations: route-level max_prefill_tokens, lossy_prefill_trim, model-variant fallback, and edge hard-reject for extreme sizes. Node cordoned and allocator hotfix planned.
cs-bot: Action items: 1) Support to reach out to affected customers and provide opt-out instructions if they want full-context (assigned to sam). 2) Eng to implement chunked-KV-alloc and automated fallback (assigned to priya/nina). 3) SRE to update runbook with prefill thresholds and edge reject (assigned to leo).
priya (eng-runtime): follow-ups I'll create: ticket ENG-7621 (chunked KV allocator), ENG-7622 (prefill telemetry filter), ENG-7623 (auto-fallback policy).
nina (ml-infra): I'll schedule allocator patch for next canary window and coordinate perf tests.
leo (sre): post-incident: gather pod restart hist, nvml logs, and kernel OOM traces. update runbook.
ashley (oncall): handing over to leo/priya for postmortem. closing pager at 04:05 but keep channel open for notes. thanks everyone. :white_check_mark:
incident-bot: Incident 3991234567 marked mitigated by ashley at 04:05:12
